  Share your model

Share link and model code work right away. Publish sends your model to everyone's Community tab – no account needed. Everyone can see what you publish, so use a nickname, not your real name.

 

  Publish your mod

Share link and mod code work right away. Publish sends your mod to everyone's Mods tab and the website – no account needed. Everyone can see what you publish, so use a nickname, not your real name.

  Paste a model code

  Create your own model

  1. Shape: add shapes – or draw your own – then move, turn, stretch and resize them.
  2. Color: pick a color and tap each part to color it.
  3. Motion: make parts move – choose a ready motion or create your own from poses.
  4. Share: join the parts into one model, then save it or publish it to the Community.
The most used models in the Community appear on the Top leaderboard.
